headline_marked: Harry Kane scores twice as [[England and Croatia tied 2-2]] at halftime
headline: Harry Kane scores twice as England and Croatia tied 2-2 at halftime
summary: England's captain Harry Kane netted two goals, but Croatia fought back to keep the World Cup Group L match level heading into the break.
details: England and Croatia are locked in a 2-2 draw at the end of the first half in their World Cup Group L encounter.
Harry Kane led the charge for England, scoring twice to put his side in a strong position.
The opening goal came in the 12th minute via a penalty by Kane, after a foul by Luka Modric on Noni Madueke.
Although goalkeeper Livakovic initially saved the penalty, Kane was allowed to retake it because the keeper had stepped off the line early.
Croatia responded in the 36th minute with a goal from Martin Baturina to level the score.
England regained the lead in the 42nd minute when captain Harry Kane scored a powerful header from a corner.
Just before the whistle, Petar Musa scored in the 5th minute of stoppage time to bring Croatia back to 2-2.
caption:
Harry Kane's brace isn't enough to separate them! England and Croatia head into the break tied 2-2.

England and Croatia are locked in a 2-2 draw at the end of the first half in their World Cup Group L encounter.

Harry Kane led the charge for England, scoring twice to put his side in a strong position.

The opening goal came in the 12th minute via a penalty by Kane, after a foul by Luka Modric on Noni Madueke.

Although goalkeeper Livakovic initially saved the penalty, Kane was allowed to retake it because the keeper had stepped off the line early.

Croatia responded in the 36th minute with a goal from Martin Baturina to level the score.

England regained the lead in the 42nd minute when captain Harry Kane scored a powerful header from a corner.

Just before the whistle, Petar Musa scored in the 5th minute of stoppage time to bring Croatia back to 2-2.

headline_marked: Tragedy in Mongla: [[Woman killed by crocodile attack]] while fishing
headline: Tragedy in Mongla: Woman killed by crocodile attack while fishing
summary: A woman was dragged into the water and killed by a crocodile in Mongla, Bagerhat, while she was collecting fish fry.
details: A woman was killed after being attacked and dragged away by a crocodile in Mongla, Bagerhat.
The incident occurred while the woman was engaged in catching fish fry (pona) in the water.
Witnesses reported that the crocodile suddenly attacked the woman and pulled her deep into the water.
Local authorities and residents were alerted to the tragedy, leading to search efforts in the area.
Such attacks highlight the ongoing risk for locals who rely on the coastal waters for their livelihoods.
caption:
A routine trip to catch fish fry turned fatal in Mongla when a crocodile attacked and dragged a woman into the water.

A woman was killed after being attacked and dragged away by a crocodile in Mongla, Bagerhat.

The incident occurred while the woman was engaged in catching fish fry (pona) in the water.

Witnesses reported that the crocodile suddenly attacked the woman and pulled her deep into the water.

Local authorities and residents were alerted to the tragedy, leading to search efforts in the area.

Such attacks highlight the ongoing risk for locals who rely on the coastal waters for their livelihoods.
